card.name: Spots where a nine digit is unlikely
card.fires_on: Mostly on the digit after a first digit in dates (the 2 in 28 or 20), and on commas in lists of ancient peoples such as Persians, Medes, Scythians. Also on a few digits or punctuation marks inside numbers.

modes.label: Second digit of a date
modes.description: The first digit of a day or year, where the next digit could be 9 or another number.

modes.label: Commas in lists of peoples
modes.description: Commas between names of ancient Iranian peoples in a list.

modes.description: The point inside a percentage in a data table.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the digit nine in many languages, and raises a few unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires inside dates and numbers and on commas in lists of ancient peoples, and it pushes the model away from writing a nine next.
